findings.title: Complete the ordinary corresponding-adjustment application route
findings.section: Cross-border points / Deadlines and filing / Sources
findings.evidence: ledgers/li-transfer-pricing-evidence/sources/06.txt:906–953; current official PDF independently reopened30October2026, pp23–24 and note60
findings.reason: The supplied ordinary SteG63/124a method omits the implementing SteV36d application conditions and its distinct three-calendar-month deadline. SteG124a only addresses reopening a final domestic assessment in article63(2) cases. It is not the complete deadline rule for ordinary foreign or domestic corresponding-adjustment applications.
findings.proposed_correction: Add36d: for63(2), supply comprehensive facts, original-price/method evidence, foreign authority pricing/correction evidence, proof of all reasonable foreign challenges and final foreign assessment; apply its rejection gates. For63(3), supply36d(1)(a)–(b), with its original-price defensibility rejection gate. Both requests are due within three months after finality of the assessment of the taxpayer whose taxable net profit was increased by the TP correction. Separately preserve124a: final domestic-assessment changes only for63(2), within90days of foreign-assessment finality and at most10years after the relevant tax-year end. Three calendar months and90days are distinct, and the increased-taxpayer trigger differs by route. Add ledger/source rows and read date; keep treaty/MAP cases separate.

findings.title: Supply the available corporate extension deadline and mandatory electronic route
findings.evidence: ledgers/li-transfer-pricing-evidence/sources/06.txt:1136–1161; current official PDF independently reopened30October2026, p29
findings.reason: The Guide refers to a request deadline without stating it, although LI-CORP-070 already records the exact legal rule. It also omits42a, which requires electronic creation and filing. An unverified future2027 assigned date does not prevent stating either present statutory rule.
findings.proposed_correction: State that a reasoned written six-month extension request must be made no later than30days after the general maturity date set underSteG113(3), requires provisional-bill payment, and any exceptional further request must precede first-extension expiry. Add mandatory use of the authority-provided electronic program, issued passcode and electronic41(2)attachments under42a. Do not infer the actual2027 calendar or a successful private filing. Add42a ledger/source rows.
